params.body:
## Why

A trial that passed waits for a person to read the source's terms of use and admit it. Nothing in the Observatory could do that: admitting was a command on the server. The pipeline now has the route and looks the terms up (Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline, "Admitting a source moves into the tool, with its terms looked up"); this is the place where a person uses it.

## What

A block "Passed their trial" at the top of the Sources page, shown only when there is one.

- Per source: what the trial brought (signals, share kept against all sources, share that no other source brought).
- What was found about the terms: a link to the page and the sentence the suggestion rests on, with how the Observatory reads it. When nothing could be told, the reason and a link to what was read. When it has not been looked up yet, a link to the site.
- The person chooses what the terms say. The choice starts empty and there is no button until it is made; the suggestion is never filled in for them.
- The button says what will happen: "Admit <name>" on terms that allow a paid product, "Turn <name> down" on terms that do not.
- Read by the whole team; the choice and the button only for those who can write.

## Checked

- `e2e/sources-passed-trials.spec.js`: a trial that has not passed is not offered; the found sentence and its link are shown; no choice is made for the person and no button exists before one; the chosen terms are what is sent; the confirmation says the source is admitted.
- Full e2e suite 104/104, eslint clean on the touched files.

## Order

Merge after the pipeline change is deployed. Before that the block stays hidden, because the route it reads does not answer.
params.title: Sources: admit a trial that passed, after reading its terms
